messages.author: 933e603d1b3794ab
messages.subject: Error in commonfactorGWAS()
parts:
Hello,

I am receiving the following error when I run the commonfactorGWAS() function, and I'm wondering if anyone has suggestions or insight into the issue? Please see my code (and the error) below. Thank you so much for your help!

Best wishes,
Mallory Stephenson

## Multivariable LD Score Regression ##

# Save the names of the .sumstats.gz files to "traits"
traits <- c("DPW.sumstats.gz", "ALC.sumstats.gz", "DEP.sumstats.gz", "SA.sumstats.gz")

# Save sample prevalences to "sample.prev." For continuous traits, the sample prevalence is entered as NA. For dichotomous
# traits where effective sample sizes were previously supplied (i.e., alcohol dependence and suicide attempt), the sample
# prevalence is entered as 0.5.
sample.prev = c(NA, NA, 0.5, 0.5)

# Save population prevalences to "population.prev." For continuous traits, the population prevalence is entered as NA.
population.prev <- c(NA, NA, 0.125, 0.046)

# Save trait name abbreviations to "trait.names"
trait.names = c("DPW", "ALC", "DEP", "SA")

# Run the ldsc function
LDSCoutput <- ldsc(traits, sample.prev, population.prev, ld = "eur_w_ld_chr/", wld = "eur_w_ld_chr/", trait.names)


## Prepare Summary Statistics for GWAS ##

# Save the names of the formatted summary statistics files to "files"
files <- c("/home/mstephenson/GenomicSEM/DPW.txt",
           "/home/mstephenson/GenomicSEM/AUDITC.txt",
           "/home/mstephenson/GenomicSEM/ALCDEP.txt",
           "/home/mstephenson/GenomicSEM/SuicAttempt.txt")

# Save the name of the 1000 Genomes reference file to "ref"
ref <- "/home/mstephenson/GenomicSEM/reference.1000G.maf.0.005.txt"

# Specify whether SEs are on a logistic scale
se.logit <- c(F, F, F, T)

# Specify whether the phenotype is a continuous outcome analyzed using an OLS estimator
OLS <- c(T, T, F, F)

# Specify whether the phenotype is a dichotomous outcome for which there are only Z-statistics available
linprob <- c(F, F, T, F)

# Save sample size for each trait to "N." The sample size only needs to be provided when the summary statistics file
# does not include a total sample size column.
N <- c(NA, 121604, NA, NA)

# Run the sumstats function
sumstats <- sumstats(files = files, ref = ref, trait.names = trait.names, se.logit = se.logit, OLS = OLS,
                     linprob = linprob, N = N)


## Conduct a Common Factor GWAS ##

onefac_sa <- commonfactorGWAS(LDSCoutput, sumstats, estimation = "DWLS")
